Novartis Shares Fall After Multiple Drug Trial Setbacks

Novartis shares experienced a significant decline following multiple drug trial setbacks. The company's stock hit a 52-week low after the discontinuation of Minipress XL. Additionally, a drug intended for a muscular disease failed its trial, contributing to the stock's drop. One report indicated a 10% fall in the pharma major's stock after three such setbacks.
